verificationMethod: Latest full run plus two fresh focused reruns (C32/C33) after correcting generic-role-word false positives. No model or policy changes between those runs. Raw reports retained separately.
limits: Case time includes all turns and both proposal/reply phases; multi-turn cases are longer. Live hosted inference via owner proxy; banking/screening/chain isolated and synthetic in conversation evals. Not a native-speaker panel or production bank test.
